name: vino-nuevo-workspace
description: Workspace de desarrollo para Casas de Paz - Vino Nuevo (Backend Flask + Frontend React/Vite)

scripts.dev:back: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { if (Test-Path .\venv\Scripts\python.exe) { .\venv\Scripts\python.exe backend/app.py } else { python backend/app.py } }"
scripts.test:back: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { if (Test-Path .\venv\Scripts\pytest.exe) { .\venv\Scripts\pytest.exe backend/tests } else { pytest backend/tests } }"
